description: The plot illustrates training loss as a function of iteration for six model variants listed in the legend (Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)). The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 140,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 20,000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at 0.1 increments. All six lines start near the top of the axis (around 3.4 at iteration 0), drop steeply within the first several thousand iterations, and then decrease more gradually toward the end of training. The Vanilla curve is drawn in purple with a solid line and shows a rapid early decline to roughly the mid–2.6 range by about 20,000 iterations, then continues downward to just under about 2.5 by 140,000. The StrmLLM (n=64) curve is blue with a solid line and remains higher than the others throughout, falling to roughly the high–2.7/low–2.8 range by about 20,000 iterations and ending around about 2.6 at 140,000. The SepLLM (n=64) curve is orange with a solid line, dropping to around the upper–2.6 range by about 20,000 and ending near about 2.52 by 140,000. The SepLLM (n=64, H) curve is green with a solid line, following a similar shape, reaching roughly the upper–2.6 range by about 20,000 and ending near about 2.51 by 140,000. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) curve is red with a solid line, decreasing to around the mid–2.6 range by about 20,000 and ending near about 2.50 by 140,000. The SepLLM (n=128) curve is a darker blue/purple solid line, also showing a steep initial drop to around the mid–2.6 range by about 20,000 and finishing slightly below about 2.5 by 140,000; all curves appear smooth with small fluctuations around their downward trends.
